title: RAW C54 complexion support and predominance as separate projections of one profile
summary: RAW_UNREVIEWED_NOT_SELECTED_NOT_EXECUTED. Source-specific successor: C54 permits two, three or four complexions in a person while one predominates. One profile keeps support, cardinality and predominant kind jointly, without silently importing all-four elemental membership or treating a type label as an exclusive ingredient. No target values assigned.

design.author_role: bounded independent producer; source-content construction, not test selection
design.scope: Source-first C54 local general complexion assertion; zero target forms, pages or values selected. No inheritance or repair of558/559.

source.unit: Complete short black-prose general introduction following the four-complexion rubric and before the first melancholic article: four sorts; some people two, some three, some four; one takes the upper hand; none has only one. The rest of the temperament chapter is not owned complete.
limits: Both reviewers inspected the same photograph with prior catalogue knowledge; agreement is not an independent witness.
This is a working native reading, not a diplomatic edition.
Complexion/nature membership is not automatically elemental material membership.
Neither the whole eight-surface program nor the whole four-type chapter was completed.
No quantities, threshold, treatment efficacy, patient identity or four-figure correspondence follows.

design.mechanism: A typed PROFILE binds one person/context to a support set of complexions and one predominant member. Member queries, support count and predominant classification are projections of that same profile, not three independently filled fields.

relations.HAS_COMPLEXION: PersonRef x ProfileContext x ComplexionKind -> proposition
relations.PREDOMINATES_OVER: PersonRef x ProfileContext x ComplexionKind x ComplexionKind -> proposition

fixed_requirements: S is a subset of the four ComplexionKind values; cardinality(S) is2,3or4.
For every k in S other than d, the profile asserts PREDOMINATES_OVER(person,context,d,k).
No lower-rank order, weights, proportions or absence of corresponding material elements is inferred.
The context is one explicitly co-referred description/occasion. Do not carry it across times or people without a written relation.
constructor.state_count: 28 support-and-head configurations:6 two-member supports times2 heads,4 three-member supports times3 heads,1 four-member support times4 heads. This is a derived model capacity, not a manuscript count or semantic test.
extra_modeling_assumptions: The source most/upper-hand wording is modeled as a unique head above all other present complexions.
An explicitly closed support set is stronger than an open list of mentioned types; closure must be written or separately hypothesized and counted.
A single profile context supplies the common owner/reference; no anonymous per-clause owner switch.

prospective_reuse_examples.outputs: HEAD=MELANCHOLIC; COUNT=2; SANGUINE not in complexion support.
HEAD=MELANCHOLIC; COUNT=3; SANGUINE in complexion support.
Same support/count as P2; different HEAD.

design.example_status: Declared logical witnesses, not people or mixtures explicitly named in C54 and not manuscript readings. Source supplies cardinal alternatives but not these exact member combinations.

contrast.contract: Each person is exhaustively one of four types; the classification label is the complete profile.
contrast.difference: Cannot preserve an explicit same-person two/three-member assertion by relabeling the head alone.

contrast.contract: The same ComplexionKind domain is universally present in every person; only dominance varies.
contrast.difference: COUNT remains4, conflicting with literal closed2/3-support cases under the shared domain and context.

contrast.contract: All four material elements are present, while only2–4 complexions manifest or count as descriptions.
contrast.difference: Potentially fully compatible. This is the strongest domain countercase; the card does not refute it or identify complexions with material ingredients.

contrast.contract: Two/three types are mentioned but others remain unmentioned.
contrast.difference: Same listed names, but no closed support or absence consequence. Main requires explicit list closure rather than treating mention as exhaustive.

design.prediction: With a complete written owner/context and support closure, repeated PROFILE references must preserve MEMBERS,COUNT and HEAD jointly. Same HEAD does not entail same membership; same membership does not determine HEAD. An added head cannot be outside the written support.
design.falsifier: For a prospectively fixed whole passage, a same-profile assertion requiring HEAD outside its closed support, support count1, contradictory counts, or unlicensed owner/context change defeats this contract. The serious all-element rival only differs if the relevant domains and counting convention are explicitly equated; otherwise report compatibility. No target test is currently defined or run.
target_binding_debt: Choose a complete admitted unit only in a separately authorized selection.
Write the person/context binder, set membership and closure, predominance relation and at least two reused references.
Assign every remaining group without sentence macros, hidden enumerations or per-occurrence values.
Preserve reader alternatives and current source uncertainties; no numerical four inferred from figures.

predecessors.relation: Source/model fields reviewed. Its all-element mixture and not-universal treatment-benefit quantifiers remain separate and unchanged; its own source already distinguishes predominance from membership.
Source/freedom fields reviewed; living-state feasibility and same-owner gaps are not repaired by allowing2–4 complexions.
Bounded registry navigation: set/partition coverage already exists; no novelty certified merely for naming a set.

design.novelty_status: Unreviewed source-specific successor, not certified novel logic. Changed positive input is the directly read C54 two/three/four restriction, unlike an all-four membership premise. There is no claimed new target capacity.
design.smallest_next_step: If selected later, author one whole complete-unit hypothesis with explicit support closure and at least two same-profile references, then compare HEAD-only and all-four-same-domain readings. No executor or broad corpus is needed at RAW intake.
